unknown_or_not_censused: Unnamed enemies, background actors, spawn-only variants, the large Stage6 objective spacecraft, hazards, projectiles and boss damage-state parts have not been exhaustively identified from executable spawn/model data.
Related Uhu and Star chassis models may form broader production families; those groupings need decoded geometry/runtime ownership and are not silently merged.
limitations: This is a bounded gallery/model-art inventory, not a proven total of every enemy type that can spawn.
The word enemy includes aerial units, walkers, trains, emplacements and bosses here;40 is not an aircraft-only count.
Original gallery labels establish model names. Enemy affiliation and boss roles are corroborated by a clearly labeled secondary player FAQ.
The six mapped texture upload keys belong to one observed material family; they are not six enemy ships.
Named runtime model IDs, complete per-family UV bindings and boss-part material ownership remain unvalidated.
Gold/obsidian is planned for the observed family. No new gameplay capture demonstrates that finish.
Primary reference illustrations are 640x480. They are source art, not generated material textures or screenshots of changed gameplay.
